cds.title: Tarleton State University Common Data Set 2024-2025 (PDF)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2024; the 2025-2026 edition was not posted on Tarleton's Common Data Set page). International: 33 applied, 30 admitted, 12 enrolled (residency table). Undergraduate enrollment and the 79 nonresident undergraduates are totals (15,130 incl. non-degree). SAT composite 970/1060/1150 is also published (not shown on this page). Tarleton did not report the GPA table or the average GPA, and all the admission-factor checkboxes are marked, so no factors are shown. The enrolled figure from the applications and admissions section (3,018) is higher than the degree-seeking first-time count from the enrollment section (2,581); the first figure is shown as printed.

cds_test_policy.notes: Tarleton's first-time-in-college page says SAT/ACT/CLT scores are not required for an admission decision; they are encouraged for scholarships and the TSI requirement.

cost.notes: From the Common Data Set (first-year, 2025-26; no 2026-27 figures are posted): in-state tuition $5,997, out-of-state/nonresident $18,297, required fees $4,183, food and housing $11,676. The Common Data Set lists 479 nonresident undergraduates with institutional aid (average $5,926), but the checked aid box is unreadable and that page is headed 2023-2024, so no aid figures are shown
